headline.title: What to expect from WWDC 2026: Siri’s highly anticipated revamp and Apple Intelligence updates
headline.summary: Apple's WWDC 2026 is expected to showcase a significant revamp of Siri and updates to Apple Intelligence. The event will highlight advancements in AI technology and improvements to the user experience across Apple's ecosystem.

articles.title: Five labs, five minds: building a multi-model finance drama on small models
articles.summary: A collaboration among five research labs is underway to develop a multi-model finance drama utilizing small AI models. This project aims to explore diverse perspectives and approaches in financial modeling, enhancing understanding and engagement in the field.

articles.title: The mayor of Shelbyville, Indiana, says only people who live in ‘shitty houses’ oppose data center
articles.summary: Shelbyville, Indiana's mayor, Scott Furgeson, has sparked controversy by suggesting that opposition to a proposed $2 billion data center comes primarily from residents living in "shitty houses." His comments were made in response to the increasing visibility of "No Data Center" signs throughout the city.

articles.title: Meta made its own AI-generated clickbait news feed
articles.summary: Meta has launched a new feature in its standalone AI app that generates a "For You" section filled with AI-created clickbait articles. The content, including topics, images, and text, is generated by artificial intelligence, raising concerns about the quality and reliability of the information presented.

articles.title: Sriram Krishnan is leaving his role as White House AI advisor
articles.summary: Sriram Krishnan is stepping down from his position as White House AI advisor to establish a new institution focused on influencing AI policy under Trump's administration. His departure marks a shift in the White House's approach to artificial intelligence governance.

articles.title: The Trump administration might take an equity stake in OpenAI
articles.summary: The Trump administration is exploring the possibility of taking an equity stake in OpenAI as part of discussions aimed at ensuring that the American public benefits from advancements in artificial intelligence. President Trump indicated that these deals are still in the negotiation phase.

articles.title: Crypto-Funded Chinese Peptide Labs Are Booming
articles.summary: Chinese peptide labs are experiencing significant growth, fueled by funding from cryptocurrency sources. In related news, hackers are exploiting Meta's AI bots to compromise Instagram accounts, and Anthropic is providing assistance to NSA hackers.

articles.title: Here comes new Siri again
articles.summary: Apple is set to reintroduce an updated version of Siri at the upcoming WWDC, aiming to enhance its AI capabilities after falling behind competitors in recent years. The new Siri is expected to feature improvements that reflect Apple's renewed focus on artificial intelligence.

articles.title: The latest AI news we announced in May 2026
articles.summary: In May 2026, several advancements in AI were announced, highlighting progress in natural language processing and machine learning applications. Key developments included new algorithms that improve efficiency and accuracy in data analysis across various industries.

articles.title: Beyond Output Matching: Preserving Internal Geometry in NVFP4 LLM Distillatio
articles.summary: The article discusses a new approach to quantization-aware distillation (QAD) for low-precision inference in large language models, specifically focusing on NVFP4-based methods. It emphasizes the importance of preserving internal geometry during the distillation process to improve accuracy in latency and cost-constrained environments.

articles.title: Edit-R2: Context-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Image Editing
articles.summary: The article introduces Edit-R2, a context-aware reinforcement learning approach designed for multi-turn image editing, allowing users to iteratively refine images based on a series of instructions. This method addresses the limitations of existing single-turn models by maintaining session-level constraints throughout the editing process.

articles.title: Boosting Brain-to-Image Decoding with TRIBE v2 Data Augmentation
articles.summary: Researchers have explored the use of TRIBE v2, a pretrained model of fMRI responses, to enhance brain-to-image decoding by augmenting small datasets with synthetic data. The study aims to improve decoding performance in low-data scenarios, addressing a significant limitation in the field of brain decoding.
